cfg.axiora.inlineCompletion.enabled.mark: Show AI ghost-text suggestions while you type. Press `Tab` to accept, `Esc` to dismiss. Uses the model in `#axiora.inlineCompletion.model#` — no Copilot account needed.
cfg.axiora.inlineCompletion.model.markdo:
Fill-in-the-middle model for inline suggestions, served by `#axiora.ai.provider#`.

Examples: `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` (Ollama), `codestral-latest`, `cohere/north-mini-code:free` (OpenRouter).
cfg.axiora.inlineCompletion.maxTokens.ma: Longest suggestion, in tokens. `32`–`64` keeps suggestions to a line or two; `256` allows whole blocks.
cfg.axiora.inlineCompletion.debounceMs.m: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before asking the model. Lower feels snappier; higher saves requests on paid providers.
cfg.axiora.nextEdit.enabled.markdownDesc: After you rename a word, suggest the same change at its next occurrence. Press `Tab` to jump and apply.
cfgsec.axiora.editor.axioraKeymap.title: Axiora: Keymap
cfg.axiora.keymap.markdownDescription: Built-in key bindings — no extension needed. Switch any time from the Command Palette with **Axiora: Choose Keymap...**.
cfg.axiora.keymap.enumDescriptions.1: Modal editing: Normal, Insert and Visual modes with motions, operators and text objects.
cfg.axiora.keymap.enumDescriptions.2: Emacs bindings: `Ctrl+A`/`Ctrl+E`, kill ring, mark, `Ctrl+X` prefixes.
cfgsec.axiora.editor.format.title: Axiora: EditorConfig
cfg.axiora.editorconfig.enabled.markdown: Apply [`.editorconfig`](https://editorconfig.org) rules — indentation, line endings, trailing whitespace and final newline — without installing an extension.
cfg.axiora.editor.typewriterMode.markdow: Keep the line you are typing vertically centered, like a typewriter. Toggle with **View: Toggle Typewriter Mode**.
cfgsec.axiora.editor.axioraLsp.title: Axiora: Language Servers
cfg.axiora.lsp.autoInstall.markdownDescr: What to do when you open a file whose language server Axiora can manage (Python, Bash, YAML, Dockerfile, Go, Rust, C/C++, Lua, Java, Kotlin, Terraform, R…). Manage servers with **Language Servers: Manage...**.
cfg.axiora.lsp.autoInstall.enumDescripti: Offer to download and start the server the first time it is needed.
Never download servers; only use ones already on your PATH.
cfg.axiora.lsp.disabled.markdownDescript: Server ids that are never started automatically, e.g. `["pyright", "clangd"]`.
cfg.axiora.lsp.initializationOptions.mar:
Per-server `initializationOptions`, keyed by server id.

Example: `{ "gopls": { "staticcheck": true } }`
cfg.axiora.inspections.enabled.markdownD: Built-in Axiora inspections with quick fixes for JavaScript, TypeScript and Python (unused code, risky patterns, simple bugs).
cfgsec.axiora.chat.axioraAssistant.title: Axiora: Axiora Assistant
cfg.axiora.chat.defaultParticipant.markd: Answer plain chat messages with Axiora — no need to type `@axiora`. Turn off to send plain messages to another installed assistant instead. Past chats: **Axiora: Past Conversations**.
cfg.axiora.agent.tools.markdownDescripti: Let `@axiora` call tools on its own: web search and page reading, a real browser, office files and charts, images, screenshots and message drafts. Destructive tools always follow `#axiora.approval.mode#`.
cfg.axiora.web.readPages.markdownDescrip: How many of the top results `/web` opens and reads in full before answering. `0` uses snippets only.
cfg.axiora.agents.concurrency.markdownDe: How many subagents `/parallel` runs at the same time. Raise it for fast local models; lower it for rate-limited providers.
cfgsec.axiora.chat.context.title: Axiora: Axiora Context
cfg.axiora.context.repoMap.markdownDescr: Include a compact map of the repository (files and top-level symbols) in `@axiora` prompts. Files matching `.axioraignore` are skipped.
cfg.axiora.context.fastContext.markdownD: Find the code most relevant to each prompt by keyword search and add it to the context.
cfg.axiora.context.liveActions.markdownD: Include what you are doing right now — active file, recent edits, terminal commands and errors — so answers match your current task.
cfg.axiora.context.extraRepos.markdownDe: Other repository folders whose file lists are included, e.g. `["~/code/shared-lib"]`.
cfg.axiora.docs.maxPages.markdownDescrip: Maximum pages crawled for each documentation source added with **Docs: Add Documentation...**.
cfgsec.axiora.chat.axioraMemory.title: Axiora: Memory
cfg.axiora.memory.enabled.markdownDescri: Include `.axiora/memory.md` in every `@axiora` prompt. Add notes with `/remember` or **Axiora AI: Add to Memory...**.
cfg.axiora.chat.maxContextTokens.markdow: When a conversation grows past this many (estimated) tokens, older turns are summarized automatically so the chat keeps going.
cfg.axiora.chat.seriesLimit.markdownDesc: Messages per conversation part (yours and Axiora's together). When a part fills up, Axiora quietly continues in the next part — e.g. **Project 1 → Project 2** — carrying a summary forward so nothing is lost. Browse all parts with **Axiora: Past Conversations**. `0` turns this off.
cfg.axiora.checkpoints.autoOnSave.markdo: Create a checkpoint automatically when you save (at most every 5 minutes). Restore with **Axiora AI: Restore Checkpoint...**.
cfg.axiora.lintFix.onSave.markdownDescri: After saving, let the AI fix the errors left in the file, re-checking until it is clean or `#axiora.lintFix.maxIterations#` is reached.
cfgsec.axiora.features.axioraSolo.title: Axiora: Solo Agent
cfg.axiora.solo.testCommand.markdownDesc: Command `/solo` runs to verify its work, e.g. `npm test`, `pytest -q` or `cargo test`. Empty uses `npm test` when `package.json` has a test script.
cfg.axiora.solo.maxIterations.markdownDe: How many write-test-fix rounds `/solo` may run before stopping.
cfgsec.axiora.features.axioraLatex.title: Axiora: LaTeX
cfg.axiora.latex.engine.enumDescriptions: Unicode, system fonts and Lua scripting.
Self-contained engine that downloads packages on demand.
cfg.axiora.latex.buildOnSave.markdownDes: Rebuild the PDF whenever you save while its preview is open.
cfg.axiora.latex.viewerDpi.markdownDescr: Render resolution (DPI) of the SyncTeX PDF preview. Higher is sharper but slower.
cfg.axiora.container.engine.markdownDesc: Container engine for container debugging and runner isolation.
cfg.axiora.wasi.replace.markdownDescript: When a WASI plugin runs on the document or selection, replace it with the output. Turn off to open the output in a new tab instead.
cfg.axiora.approval.mode.markdownDescrip: When to ask before the agent does something destructive or visible to others — deleting files, `git push`, risky shell commands, deploys, and sending messages (sends always ask). Change quickly with **Axiora AI: Set Approval Mode...**.
cfg.axiora.approval.mode.enumDescription: Confirm deletes, pushes, destructive commands, deploys and sends (recommended).
Confirm every agent action, including file writes and safe commands.
Confirm only high-risk actions such as force-push, recursive delete, deploys and sends.
cfg.axiora.security.scanOnSave.markdownD: Scan files for leaked secrets and insecure code when you open or save them. Findings appear in the **Problems** panel.
cfg.axiora.sandbox.engine.markdownDescri: Isolation used by **Run Current File in Sandbox**.
cfg.axiora.sandbox.engine.enumDescriptio: JavaScript only: no child processes or workers, file reads limited to the workspace, writes to `.axiora/sandbox-out`.
Any language in a container with no network and a read-only workspace.
cfg.axiora.policy.url.markdownDescriptio: Optional JSON policy (`{"exclude": [...], "redact": [...]}`) served from your own server. Merged with `.axiora/policy.json` to keep files and secrets out of AI requests.
cfg.axiora.sync.endpoint.markdownDescrip: Your own settings-sync server, e.g. `https://sync.example.com/api/sync`. Leave empty to turn sync off. Set the token with **Axiora Sync: Set Token...**.
cfg.axiora.dotfiles.repository.markdownD: Your dotfiles: a Git URL, `owner/repo` on GitHub, or a local folder.
cfg.axiora.dotfiles.targetPath.markdownD: Folder the repository is cloned into.
cfg.axiora.dotfiles.installCommand.markd: Command run after cloning. Empty runs `install.sh`, `bootstrap.sh` or `setup.sh` (`install.ps1` on Windows), otherwise links the dotfiles into your home folder.
cfg.axiora.dotfiles.installOnStartup.mar: Pull and apply your dotfiles every time the editor starts.
cfg.axiora.dotfiles.ignore.markdownDescr: Files that are never linked into your home folder, e.g. `[".gitconfig"]`.
cfg.axiora.agent.keepAwake.markdownDescr: Prevent the computer from sleeping while `@axiora`, `/solo` or background tasks are running.
cfgsec.axiora.aiModels.key.title: Axiora: AI Key
cfg.axiora.ai.apiKey.markdownDescription:
**One key is all you need.** Paste a key and Axiora detects the provider, picks a good model for chat and inline suggestions, and tests it.

`sk-or-…` OpenRouter · `gsk_…` Groq · `AIza…` Gemini · `sk-ant-…` Anthropic · `sk-…` OpenAI

The key is kept in the OS keychain — never in `settings.json`. Image, voice and speech use this key unless you set their own. Also in **Axiora: Set Up AI** and [Connected Services](command:axiora.services.open).
cfgsec.axiora.aiModels.provider.title: Axiora: Provider
cfg.axiora.ai.provider.markdownDescripti: Where models run. Set the API key with **Axiora AI: Set API Key...** (stored in the OS keychain) and check it with **Axiora AI: Test Model Connection**.
Models on your machine through Ollama — private and free.
Any OpenAI-compatible server: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Groq, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM…
cfg.axiora.ai.baseUrl.markdownDescriptio:
Server address.

- Ollama: `http://127.0.0.1:11434`
- OpenRouter: `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`
- OpenAI: `https://api.openai.com/v1`
- LM Studio: `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1`
cfg.axiora.ai.chatModel.markdownDescript: Model for `@axiora` chat, `/review`, `/spec` and the agents. Inline suggestions use `#axiora.inlineCompletion.model#`.
cfgsec.axiora.aiModels.router.title: Axiora: Model Router
cfg.axiora.ai.router.enabled.markdownDes: Pick a model per request: short, simple prompts go to `#axiora.ai.router.smallModel#`, long or complex ones to `#axiora.ai.router.largeModel#`.
cfg.axiora.ai.router.smallModel.markdown: Fast, cheap model for short questions, e.g. `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b`.
cfg.axiora.ai.router.largeModel.markdown: Strong model for refactors, debugging, design and long code.
cfg.axiora.ai.router.threshold.markdownD: Prompt size in characters above which the large model is used.
cfgsec.axiora.aiModels.cost.title: Axiora: Cost
cfg.axiora.ai.costPer1kInputTokens.markd: Used by **Axiora AI: Show Usage** to estimate spend. Use `0` for local models.
cfgsec.axiora.aiModels.vision.title: Axiora: Vision and Embeddings
cfg.axiora.ai.visionModel.markdownDescri: Model that accepts images, used for screenshot-to-UI and computer use, e.g. `qwen2.5vl` or `llava`. Empty uses the chat model.
cfg.axiora.ai.embeddingModel.markdownDes: Embedding model for the semantic code index, e.g. `nomic-embed-text`. Falls back to local hashed vectors when unavailable.
cfgsec.axiora.aiModels.image.title: Axiora: Image Generation
cfg.axiora.image.model.markdownDescripti: Model used by `/image`. OpenRouter: an image-output model such as `google/gemini-2.5-flash-image`. OpenAI: `gpt-image-1`. Set a separate key with **Image: Set Image API Key...**.
cfg.axiora.image.api.enumDescriptions.0: OpenRouter uses chat with image output; everything else uses `/images/generations`.
cfg.axiora.image.folder.markdownDescript: Folder, relative to the workspace, where generated images are saved.
cfgsec.axiora.aiModels.arena.title: Axiora: Arena
cfg.axiora.arena.models.markdownDescript: Models compared side by side in `/arena`, e.g. `["qwen2.5-coder:7b", "llama3.1:8b"]`. Empty uses every available model.
cfgsec.axiora.voice.stt.title: Axiora: Speech to Text
cfg.axiora.voice.provider.markdownDescri: Where dictation is transcribed. Start dictation with **Voice: Dictate**.
cfg.axiora.voice.provider.enumDescriptio: A whisper.cpp server on your machine (`#axiora.voice.endpoint#`) — private and offline.
Groq, OpenAI or any `/audio/transcriptions` endpoint (`#axiora.voice.baseUrl#`). Set the key with **Voice: Set Speech-to-Text API Key...**.
cfg.axiora.voice.endpoint.markdownDescri:
whisper.cpp server URL, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8080/inference`.

Start one with `whisper-server -m ggml-base.bin --port 8080` (multilingual, supports Arabic; avoid `.en` models, which are English only).
cfg.axiora.voice.model.markdownDescripti: Transcription model. Empty uses `whisper-1` locally and `whisper-large-v3-turbo` online.
cfgsec.axiora.voice.tts.title: Axiora: Text to Speech
cfg.axiora.voice.tts.provider.markdownDe: Voice used by the **Read aloud** button under chat replies.
cfg.axiora.voice.tts.provider.enumDescri: Windows speech, macOS `say`, or Linux `spd-say`/`espeak-ng` — offline and free.
An `/audio/speech` endpoint such as OpenAI. Set the key with **Voice: Set Text-to-Speech API Key...**.
cfg.axiora.voice.tts.autoSpeak.markdownD: Read every `@axiora` reply aloud as soon as it finishes. Stop with **Voice: Stop Speaking**.
cfg.axiora.voice.tts.rate.markdownDescri: Speaking speed from `-10` (slowest) to `10` (fastest). `0` is normal.
cfg.axiora.voice.tts.osVoice.markdownDes: Name of an installed system voice, e.g. `Microsoft Zira Desktop` (Windows) or `Samantha` (macOS). Empty uses the default.
cfg.axiora.voice.tts.model.markdownDescr: Model for the OpenAI-compatible provider, e.g. `gpt-4o-mini-tts` or `tts-1`.
cfg.axiora.voice.tts.voice.markdownDescr: Voice for the OpenAI-compatible provider, e.g. `alloy`, `nova` or `verse`.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.jira.title: Axiora: Jira
cfg.axiora.connectors.jira.token.markdow: Paste an [Atlassian API token](https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens). Needs `#axiora.connectors.jira.site#` and `#axiora.connectors.jira.email#` too — or connect everything at once in [Connected Services](command:axiora.services.open).
cfg.axiora.connectors.jira.site.markdown: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. `https://acme.atlassian.net`. Add the API token with **Connectors: Manage...**.
cfg.axiora.connectors.jira.email.markdow: Atlassian account email that owns the API token.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.google.title: Axiora: Google
cfg.axiora.google.account.markdownDescri: Sign in with your Google account for Gmail, Drive and Calendar. Uses your own OAuth client from `#axiora.google.clientId#`.
cfg.axiora.google.clientId.markdownDescr: Your own Google OAuth client (type **Desktop app**) for Gmail, Drive and Calendar. Create it in the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials), then run **Google: Sign In...** — the client secret is kept in the OS keychain.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.figma.title: Axiora: Figma
cfg.axiora.connectors.figma.token.markdo: Paste a [Figma personal access token](https://www.figma.com/developers/api#access-tokens) (read-only *File content* scope is enough). Use `/figma <file-url>` in chat.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.slack.title: Axiora: Slack
cfg.axiora.connectors.slack.token.markdo: Paste a [Slack bot or user token](https://api.slack.com/apps) (`xoxb-…` or `xoxp-…`). Stored for Slack-aware agent tools.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.linear.title: Axiora: Linear
cfg.axiora.connectors.linear.token.markd: Paste a [Linear personal API key](https://linear.app/settings/account/security) (`lin_api_…`). Use `/linear` in chat.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.stripe.title: Axiora: Stripe
cfg.axiora.connectors.stripe.token.markd: Paste a [Stripe restricted key](https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys) (`rk_…`, read-only recommended). Use `/stripe` in chat.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.github.title: Axiora: GitHub
cfg.axiora.github.token.markdownDescript: Sign in with GitHub, or paste a [fine-grained token](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens). Public repos work without one.
cfg.axiora.github.repo.markdownDescripti: Repository as `owner/name`. Empty uses the `origin` remote of the open folder.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.mcp.title: Axiora: MCP Server
cfg.axiora.mcpServer.enabled.markdownDes: Expose this editor as an MCP server on `127.0.0.1`, so external agents can read open editors, the selection, files and diagnostics. Copy the client config with **MCP: Copy Server Config**.
cfg.axiora.mcpServer.port.markdownDescri: Local port for the MCP server.
cfg.axiora.mcpServer.allowWrites.markdow: Let MCP clients change files through the editor. Off keeps the server read-only.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.browser.title: Axiora: Agent Browser
cfg.axiora.browser.executablePath.markdo: Chrome, Edge or Chromium used by the agent browser. Empty detects an installed one automatically.
cfg.axiora.browser.headless.markdownDesc: Run the agent browser without showing its window.
cfg.axiora.browser.maxSteps.markdownDesc: Most actions **Browser: Run Task...** may take before stopping.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.remote.title: Axiora: Remote and Sharing
cfg.axiora.runner.machines.markdownDescr: Self-hosted runners (`bin/axiora-runner.mjs`) that take agent tasks, e.g. `[{"name": "build-box", "url": "http://10.0.0.5:7788"}]`. Tokens are kept in the OS keychain.
cfg.axiora.collab.relayUrl.markdownDescr: Your self-hosted relay for live collaboration (`node bin/axiora-relay.mjs`). Messages are end-to-end encrypted; the relay sees only ciphertext.
cfg.axiora.share.endpoint.markdownDescri: Server that publishes shared chats: receives `POST {title, markdown, html}` and returns `{url}`.
cfg.axiora.embed.baseUrl.markdownDescrip: Public address where you host `.axiora/embeds`; used in copied iframe snippets.
cfg.axiora.acp.agents.markdownDescriptio: External agents spoken to over the Agent Client Protocol, e.g. `[{"name": "gemini", "command": "gemini", "args": ["--experimental-acp"]}]`. Cursor is added automatically from the downloaded CLI (`agent acp`) unless an entry named `cursor` is already listed.
cfgsec.axiora.integrations.cursor.title: Axiora: Cursor
cfg.axiora.cursor.enabled.markdownDescri: Download the official Cursor CLI into Axiora's data folder and run it inside the editor over ACP. Sign-in uses your own Cursor account (`agent login`). No API key is stored in the app.
cfg.axiora.cursor.cliPath.markdownDescri: Override path to the Cursor CLI executable. Empty uses the copy Axiora downloads. `AXIORA_CURSOR_CLI` overrides this.
cmd.axiora.cursor.signIn.title: Sign In with Cursor
cmd.axiora.cursor.status.title: Cursor Account Status
chat.axiora.local.description: Local AI (Ollama / your own key): review, specs, memory
chat.axiora.local.cmd.spec: Plan a feature: requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md
chat.axiora.local.cmd.remember: Save a note to the project memory
chat.axiora.local.cmd.checkpoint: Create a checkpoint of the workspace
chat.axiora.local.cmd.regex: Build a regular expression from a description
chat.axiora.local.cmd.improve: Rewrite a prompt to be specific and complete
chat.axiora.local.cmd.map: Show the repository map (files and symbols)
chat.axiora.local.cmd.web: Search the web and answer with sources
chat.axiora.local.cmd.goal: Break a goal into dependency-ordered tasks
chat.axiora.local.cmd.waves: Show parallel execution waves for the open tasks file
chat.axiora.local.cmd.share: Share this conversation (link via your server, or HTML file)
chat.axiora.local.cmd.arena: Compare two models side by side (blind) and vote
chat.axiora.local.cmd.docs: Answer from indexed external documentation (#name to pick a source)
chat.axiora.local.cmd.recall: Find past conversations (use #chat:<words> to include one)
chat.axiora.local.cmd.parallel: Split into subtasks, run subagents in parallel, merge
chat.axiora.local.cmd.subagent: Run one isolated subagent (role: task) and get its summary
chat.axiora.local.cmd.data: Ask about your live data session (variables, current cell)
chat.axiora.local.cmd.artifact: Produce a durable artifact (doc, plan, diagram, script) in .axiora/artifacts
chat.axiora.local.cmd.artifacts: Produce several complementary artifacts at once
chat.axiora.local.cmd.background: Run a task in the background without blocking the chat
chat.axiora.local.cmd.prototype: Build a runnable app prototype from a description ('refine: …' to iterate)
chat.axiora.local.cmd.caps: Show and toggle agent capability chips
chat.axiora.local.cmd.solo: SOLO: autonomous write → test → fix loop for a goal
chat.axiora.local.cmd.cloud: Run a task on your self-hosted runner (isolated workspace)
chat.axiora.local.cmd.handoff: Hand this chat + branch over to your runner
chat.axiora.local.cmd.semantic: Semantic code search over the local embeddings index
chat.axiora.local.cmd.acp: Talk to an external ACP agent: [name] <prompt>
chat.axiora.local.cmd.figma: Pull a Figma file/frame (URL or key) and implement it
chat.axiora.local.cmd.stripe: Stripe data: customers, charges, invoices, subscriptions, events
chat.axiora.local.cmd.image: Generate an image (saved to the project)
chat.axiora.local.cmd.browser: Let the agent drive a real browser for a task
chat.axiora.local.cmd.chart: Render a chart image from a description
chat.axiora.local.cmd.drive: Google Drive: recent files or search
cfg.axiora.chat.responseLanguage.markdow: Language of the assistant's conversational replies. **Auto** follows the language you write in (falls back to the display language). Code, identifiers, file contents and code comments are always written in English.
cfg.axiora.chat.responseLanguage.enumDes: Same language as your message; display language when unclear.
cfg.axiora.voice.language.markdownDescri: Spoken language for dictation. **Auto** lets a multilingual Whisper model detect it. For Arabic use a multilingual model such as `ggml-base.bin`, `ggml-small.bin` or `whisper-large-v3-turbo` — models ending in `.en` understand English only.
cfg.axiora.voice.language.enumDescriptio: Detect the language automatically (multilingual model required).
cmd.axiora.drafts.open.title: Open Draft
